name: Pricely – Dynamic Pricing & Cart Discounts for WooCommerce
author: sundayfanz

sections.description:
Take complete control over your store’s pricing and promotional strategies with Pricely – Dynamic Pricing & Cart Discounts – a high-performance plugin built for flexibility, speed, and results.

Whether you’re managing bulk pricing, seasonal flash sales, or membership-based discounts, this plugin gives you a flexible, rules-based campaigns to handle it all effortlessly.

YOU MAY ALSO NEED THESE OTHER PLUGINS

✅ wModes – Catalog Mode, Product Pricing, Enquiry Forms & Promotions | for WooCommerce: Easily set up catalog modes, prices and marketing strategies on your WooCommerce store.

✅ Shipped – Table Rate Shipping Method | for WooCommerce: A powerful, flexible and easy-to-use shipping plugin for WooCommerce, it can be used to create multiple shipping rates based on product rules and conditions.

✅ PCOD – Partial COD, Payment Gateway Restrictions & Fees | for WooCommerce: A powerful, flexible and easy-to-use WooCommerce extension that can be used to manage payment availability and other gateway-related cart settings based on product rules and conditions.

✅ WooCommerce Smart Pack – Gift Card, Wallet, Refund & Reward: A WordPress plugin that allows merchants to implement a wallet system, reward or refund customers and sell an unlimited number of gift card products on their website. These features are grouped into four different extensions, the extensions include WooCommerce Wallets, WooCommerce Refunds, WooCommerce Rewards and WooCommerce Gift Cards. Each of these extensions can be enabled or disabled depending on what features are needed on a website.
